name: pl-cross-border
description: Polish cross-border personal income tax (PIT) for tax year 2026. Covers individual residence (centre of vital interests or over 183 days, PIT Act art. 3), non-residents and Polish-source income (art. 3 ust. 2a-2b), the return relief for people moving to Poland (ulga na powrót, art. 21 ust. 1 pkt 152: four years, PLN 85,528 a year), withholding on payments to non-resident individuals (20% on fees, royalties and advisory services, 19% on dividends and interest, art. 29 and 30a), certificates of residence, IFT-1R and PIT-8AR, exemption with progression and credit (art. 27 ust. 8-9a), the abolition relief (art. 27g, PLN 1,360 cap), and individual exit tax (art. 30da-30df: 19% or 3% above PLN 4,000,000, PIT-NZ). Trigger on: moving to Poland, leaving Poland, non-resident, ulga na powrót, ulga abolicyjna, certyfikat rezydencji, IFT-1R, PIT-NZ, exit tax Poland. Out of scope: companies (pl-cit-corporate-tax), transfer pricing (pl-transfer-pricing), sole-trader computation (pl-income-tax), inves
